light: cool ceiling spot above the case, a single warm glow rising from inside the case
prompt: A dim museum gallery at night. One young woman in a cream knit sweater stands with her back squarely to the camera, her shoulder and dark hair filling the left third of frame, her right hand resting flat on the glass of an illuminated display case. Inside the case a long black carved stone stele lies on a pale plinth. The glass across from her reflects the carved stone face of the stele and the dim gallery beyond it, carrying the bright wedge-cut marks clearly. The gallery stands empty and quiet behind her. Cool ceiling light above, one warm glow rising from inside the case, polished floor catching a faint sheen. Fine 35mm grain, black point slightly lifted.
